url_ownership.how_a_page_moves: In stages that never break a working address: the platform serves the page first (P1), its canonical and sitemap entry move (P2), and only then does its old address answer 301 to the same path on the platform, query intact (P3). Static files, embed.html, sw.js, manifest.json and carry.html answer on both hosts and never 301 (both_hosts). Sessions move through the carry page (carry.html on the profile host, js/carry.js on the platform, P1), never with a token in a URL; when the carry finds nothing, one clear line asks once. Returns follow the request (P0): a checkout or account return goes back to the origin it started from when that origin is on the generated site list. The 2026-10 reasons for keeping the company apps where they were are answered: sessions are per origin (the carry moves them; measured same-site in Chromium, 2026-11-23), checkout returns were hard-coded (they follow the request), and the Supabase redirect allowlist already names https://mccluster.org/** (owner, 2026-11-18).

stages.name: the platform serves everything
stages.state: shipping: built on its own branch, it ships on the owner's word
stages.what: The platform serves every platform and profile page at its path (the World at /, the HERE front door at /index.html); profile_only pages answer 301 to the profile host; www sends everything to the apex; humanuprise.com, once routed, 301s to the platform; the platform's manifest starts its app on the World; the bar is local on the platform, and from the profile host it points the Globe at the platform's World and, until P3, keeps Music, the account and an artist's page on the profile host (the amendment of 2026-11-24); the carry is on and the fragment hand-off writer is off; the installed app's move card shows on the profile host in standalone mode. The bar's and the World's host changes are made in the engine's three files, as small named functions reading window.MCC_SITE (js/tabbar.js, js/world-audio-continuity.js, js/music-shell.js; scripts/test/site-hosts-engine.test.mjs), and their host literals left with them (scripts/test/site-hosts-pending/engine.json is empty). Canonicals, sitemaps and structured data unchanged (P2). Pages first, then the Worker.

stages.name: canonicals, sitemaps and structured data move
stages.what: Platform pages name the platform in their canonical, og:url, og:site_name and JSON-LD url and isPartOf; profile pages keep theirs; @ids never move. Two sitemaps, two robots.txt, two llms.txt. The owner adds mccluster.org to Search Console and sets Supabase's Site URL.

stages.name: the profile host answers 301s for the pages that moved
stages.what: First the Worker ships the P3 table (edge.now.stage P3, so profile_host_routed is true); then the owner's Cloudflare steps (SSL rule check, proxy the matthew record, the route matthew.mccluster.org/* to Worker mccluster): platform pages on his host answer 301 to the platform; profile, profile_only and both_hosts paths answer 200 from the static origin through the Worker. A route added before the P3 table only passes his host to GitHub untouched.

stages.name: clean-up
stages.what: After 30 quiet days: the fragment hand-off reader, the World-host special cases in the bar, the v1 aliases in this record and unused frame-ancestors entries go.

stages.name: equityuprise.com becomes the platform
stages.what: platform.origin becomes https://equityuprise.com; mccluster.org becomes McCluster Corp's own tenant (its company page and news); matthew.mccluster.org stays Matthew's tenant. Needs the zone on Cloudflare, a static origin that never redirects, and the provider lists (Supabase, CORS, the analytics collector, Search Console). Staged F1 to F3 like P1 to P3.

target._note: The host router of SPEC-PLATFORM 2.4, inside Worker mccluster (workers/mccluster/src/platform/router.js, built in P0, behind the generated table). It answers as edge.now until the switches of a later stage turn on.

router.answer: 301 to / with the query; without one, from P1, the HERE front door

router.path: platform or profile page, static file
router.answer: pass-through from the static origin, path and query (from P1; at P0 the World's rooms and the static files only, everything else 301 to the static origin)
301 to the profile host, same path, at every spelling of the address (from P1)
301 to the platform, same path and query, in one hop to the platform's own 301 where it answers one (from P1; at P0 some to the apex, the rest to the profile host)

router.path: profile or profile_only page, both_hosts path, /.well-known/acme-challenge/...

router.answer: 301 to the platform root with the query (from P3)

router.path: platform page (any other .html or directory path)
router.answer: 301 to the platform, same path and query (from P3)
301 to the platform, same path and query, in one hop (from P1, once routed)

target.pass_through_rules: Never follow an upstream redirect (fetch with redirect manual, rewrite a Location on the static origin to the requesting host); headers by class (documents, embed.html with no frame restriction, carry.html framed by the platform only, static files as today); no noindex on platform or profile pages served by the platform; from P1 the documents the record names are kept at the edge 60 s (the carry page aside; workers/mccluster/src/platform/router.js DOCUMENT_CACHE_TTL), static files keep the static origin's caching.

activation_owner_steps: Read SPEC-PLATFORM, say go, and confirm or change the five owner_decisions.
After P2 ships: Google Search Console, add mccluster.org (its DNS verification is in place) and submit https://mccluster.org/sitemap.xml; Supabase, set the Site URL to https://mccluster.org.

When P3 is ready (about ten minutes, in Cloudflare): check the SSL/TLS mode and add a Configuration Rule with SSL Full for matthew.mccluster.org if the zone is Full (strict); switch the matthew CNAME to Proxied; add the Workers Route matthew.mccluster.org/* to Worker mccluster. To undo: delete the route.
In Cloudflare, check that the Workers plan covers every page and file going through the Worker.
On the iPhone: open mccluster.org in Safari, check the sign-in, add it to the Home Screen, open the new icon, keep the albums again if it offers, then delete the old icon.
Later, for equityuprise.com: move its DNS from WordPress.com to Cloudflare, then pick the day.
edge.mx_note: mccluster.org mail is Google Workspace MX. Routing HTTP to a Worker does not touch MX; do not replace the apex DNS record with a Worker custom domain without checking the MX and TXT records survive.

human_uprise.target: humanuprise.com/* and www.humanuprise.com/* routed to Worker mccluster. From P1 the router (workers/mccluster/src/platform/router.js, called by workers/mccluster/src/human-uprise/router.js) answers every path on either host with a 301 to the same path and query on the platform; before P1 it served the World at / and the World's rooms and files from the personal origin, and answered every other path with a 301 to https://matthew.mccluster.org/$1.
activation_owner_steps: Merge and deploy; confirm https://api.mccluster.org/v1/health reports the merged SHA.
Cloudflare -> humanuprise.com zone -> Workers Routes: humanuprise.com/* and www.humanuprise.com/* -> Worker mccluster, with proxied DNS records and no redirect rule in front.
Verify: curl -I https://humanuprise.com/ and https://humanuprise.com/album.html (301 to the same path on https://mccluster.org); https://www.humanuprise.com/ (301 to https://mccluster.org/).
human_uprise.decided: Owner default of 2026-11-23 (owner_decisions.humanuprise_com): once routed, humanuprise.com answers 301 to the platform, same path and query; the router answers so from P1. Its auth addresses need no Supabase entry, since nothing is served there, and pointing the Globe at it is superseded.
